easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Transguild Promenade.
When Transguild Promenade enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Transguild Promenade.
Resolve the Transguild Promenade trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Transguild Promenade from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
